name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Set the focus ring to 3px wide with 7:1 contrast and no animation. This meets WCAG AAA for keyboard users and avoids motion triggers for vestibular-sensitive users. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings, but they’re clearer and more reliable across devices.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 7:1 contrast still risks losing users on high-DPI screens where pixels blur—thicker rings look fuzzy. Use a 2px ring at 4.5:1 with a 1px inner glow at 7:1 instead; it’s sharper on all devices and meets WCAG AA while avoiding motion. Test it on a 4K screen with Windows Magnifier—if the glow stays crisp, the decision sticks.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px inner glow at 7:1. This keeps the ring sharp on high-DPI screens while meeting WCAG AA and AAA in different contexts. The trade-off is a slightly more complex style rule, but it guarantees clarity for everyone, including users with low vision or on high-resolution displays.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring with a 1px inner glow at 7:1 contrast still blurs on high-DPI screens—Windows Magnifier will soften the glow into a smudge. Use a solid 3px ring at 7:1 contrast instead; it’s sharper, meets WCAG AAA, and avoids the blur risk. Settle it with a side-by-side test on a 4K screen at 150% zoom—if the ring stays crisp, it’s the call.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast, no animation, solid stroke—tested sharp on 4K at 150% zoom. Owner: accessibility-w1.
